title: Aye Akbar
body:
Umme Laila Ne Kaha Ey Mere Noor e Nazar
Ey Mere Lakhte Jigar Ey Akbar
Mai Na Bhulungi Kabhi Zulm Ki vo Barchi or tera zakhme jigar ey akbar
Hasrto aas ke tufan liye baithi thi
Mai Tere byah ka armaan liye baithi thi
ye khabar mujhko na thi ek din dekhungi
Mai tujhe khoon Mai tar ey akbar
Mujhko Taqdeer agar din vo dikhati beta
Tera sehra Mai duaon say sajati beta
Mere hum shakle nabi Karti dum naad e Ali
Mai Tere sehre par ey akbar
Mere yusuf teri Barat na jaane payi
Rang hai teri dulhan Ghar Mai na aane payi
Kohey Ghum Yo'n tuta sath tera chuta
Lut gaya Mera Ghar ey akbar
Ey mere Noor e Nazar lakhte Jigar meri jaa'n
Dekhlu teri dulhan Dil Mai yahi tha arma'n
Khwab jo they mere ho na paste purey
Phat gaya Mera jigar ey akbar
Maine rakkha hai Tere byah ka silkar
Kaise rakhhungi bhala ab Mai jigar par Patthar
Zindagi guzregi ab toe is madar ki
Raat din Rorokar ey akbar
Ey mere Lal tujhe bhool na paungi Mai
Ashk aakhon say dino raat bahaungi Mai
Zindagi hai Jub Tak mere pyare tab Tak
Roungi Mai tujh par ey akbar
Sath pardes Mai amma ka na chhodo pyare
Maa say mooh esy gharibi may na modo pyare
Mere naazo ke paley uth ke lag jao galey
Hai pareshaN madar ey akbar
Bain Karti rahi Akbar vo ghamo ki pyari
Rokey waiz ye sada Deti rahi dukhyari
Mar Gaye tum beta rehgai Mai zinda
Ab jiyu'n ghutghut kar ey akbar
